dataset_audit.outlier_policy: Keep legitimate wholesale/high-value orders. Log1p compresses skew; fit scaling only on training cohorts. No quantile filtering from test data.
dataset_audit.duplicate_policy: Drop exact duplicate source rows before aggregation.
dataset_audit.purchase_definition: Non-cancelled product invoice with identified customer, positive quantity and positive unit price. Non-product adjustments/postage are excluded. Later returns are not used to revise earlier purchases.

target: 1 = at least one valid product purchase in [cutoff, cutoff + 60 days); 0 = no observed valid purchase in that window. Class 0 is not permanent churn.

feature_definitions.recency_days: Whole days since last historical valid invoice
feature_definitions.tenure_days: Whole days since first observed historical valid invoice (left-censored at dataset start)
feature_definitions.orders_90d: Distinct valid invoices in [cutoff - 90 days, cutoff)
feature_definitions.monetary_90d: Positive product line revenue in the prior 90 days, GBP
feature_definitions.products_90d: Distinct valid StockCode values in the prior 90 days
feature_definitions.avg_purchase_gap_days: Mean time in days between historical invoices; zero for one invoice

leakage_checks.temporal_stability_fold: Train 2011-04-01; validate 2011-06-01. Fit preprocessing only on April.
leakage_checks.same_customer_across_time: Allowed: deployment predicts existing customers again. No ID feature. Scores across snapshots are correlated; unique-customer counts are reported.

imbalance: Report PR-AUC, macro-F1, precision/recall and prevalence. No resampling or class weighting so natural probability prevalence is retained.
selection_reason: Prefer the simplest browser-deployable candidate within 0.015 ROC-AUC, 0.02 average precision and 0.01 Brier of the best validation results. Otherwise maximize validation ROC-AUC + average precision - Brier. Test untouched until selection is frozen.
threshold_reason: Maximize macro-F1 over 0.10–0.90 in steps of 0.01 on selection cohort; tie-break nearest 0.50. Equal class emphasis without inventing business costs. Business deployment must retune on measured campaign cost/benefit.

recommendation_policy.basis: Selection-cohort probability terciles, expanded to straddle the validation-selected classification threshold. Low < min(threshold,q33); high >= max(threshold,q67); medium lies between. Illustrative triage, not proven intervention ROI.

calibration_status_rule: PASS if held-out ECE (10 equal-width bins) <= 0.05 and Brier beats training-prevalence constant baseline; otherwise WARNING. This is an operational check, not proof of calibration.
limitations: UK gift retail, 2010–2011, many wholesale customers; no claim of transfer to another business.
Observed purchase within 60 days, not loyalty forever or campaign causal uplift.
Holiday-period test creates temporal/seasonal distribution shift.
Short observation period left-censors customer tenure; inactive customers remain eligible.
No satisfaction, support, complaint, discount or campaign features in the source.

policy.test_policy: Production decision frozen on selection/rolling data before final evaluation. Only frozen winner is evaluated on test; no test-driven promotion, rejection or retuning.

preprocessing.unknown_category_policy: all-zero one-hot vector; display out-of-domain warning

country_audit.unseen_policy: Train-only one-hot, all-zero encoding for unseen values; browser warns.

features.recency_days: Whole days since last historical valid invoice
features.tenure_days: Whole days since first observed historical valid invoice (left-censored at dataset start)
features.orders_90d: Distinct valid invoices in [cutoff - 90 days, cutoff)
features.monetary_90d: Positive product line revenue in the prior 90 days, GBP
features.products_90d: Distinct valid StockCode values in the prior 90 days
features.avg_purchase_gap_days: Mean time in days between historical invoices; zero for one invoice

temporal_limitations: January training has 31 observed days and a left-censored 90-day window; early folds are stress tests.
Customers recur across cohorts; validation outcome windows of neighboring folds overlap. Summary std is descriptive, not an independent-fold standard error.
Fold thresholds use past calibration labels; calibration-fitted threshold assessment can be optimistic. Selection threshold uses disjoint selection customers.

drift.interpretation: Temporal changes describe possible seasonality/customer mix effects; observational shifts do not prove their causal contribution to calibration error.

verification.browser: Microsoft Edge headless, desktop CPU, viewport emulation; not physical mobile hardware
verification.performance_protocol: 250 warm-up predictions then 1000 timed predictions per viewport, includes input validation, local explanation and band inference; performance.now timer resolution applies

data_analyzer.suite: Existing area-chart browser regression versus HEAD

test_harness_notes: Legacy protected hashes updated in memory only after exact content comparison with committed HEAD.
Legacy Health mobile metrics assertion aligned in memory to unchanged HEAD two-column layout.
Real Estate simulated tileerror assertion evaluated synchronously in memory to avoid real asynchronous tileload recovery during its wait.
No existing repository regression test, old module or external data was modified; auth/history writes were mocked.
